reviews.text: We we're referraled to Salinas roofing by a friend after our roof was damaged by hail. This was our very first time getting the roof repaired and we didn't know what to expect. Luckily, Nicholas helped us with every step of the way. He explained how the insurance would be handled, the materials that would be used, how long it would take, and answer any questions we had. The previous homeowner had the roof repaired previously and in comparison Salinas roofing did such a better job and added things the other company's didn't even bother to do. We found out our kitchen hood wasn't even vented! Nicolas has no problem with making sure that it got connect so we were up to code. We did need skylight cover that were on back order. Nicholas kept us informed on the status as to when it would be installed. Overall we are 100% satisfied with our roof repair experience. It looks amazing. We would absolutely recommend them to any of our friends and family.
reviews.author: Sil Thinna

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Salinas Roofing was absolutely outstanding! They took great care of my property and managed the entire process with my insurance company — all without me having to be present. That was such a relief since my schedule was packed, and it allowed me to focus on other things without worrying about the roof replacement. The team was fast, clean, and professional, finishing everything in a very short timeframe. No stress, no headaches — just quality work and smooth communication. Highly recommended
reviews.author: Bosanac Hadzi

reviews.text: Nicholas installed a new roof on our house. His team also painted and installed new flooring in 3 rooms. He completed the roof in one day and all of the interior work in a week. We are very happy with his work and I would highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: L G

reviews.text: Nicholas Salinas - Salinas Roofing was amazing. I am in the real estate business and work with contrators and companies all the time and it is difficult finding reliable, honest and trustworthy companies, but not Nick. He was on point, there to meet with my insurance adjuster and was there even when I needed some additional patio work done. His foreman is just as great. They were really wonderful to work with. He also filled out my insurance form when requested by my agent and followed up on registering my roof with the warranty; pro-active. A man of his word.
reviews.author: A Bates

reviews.text: Simply speaking.....Very professional with excellent services - quality, service, and pricing. They are very responsive, timeliness, friendly and cleans up everything like it was before starting the work. This company should be your primary choice! See our pictures so attached.
reviews.author: Wayne Remig

reviews.text:
Salinas Roofing and Construction did a GREAT job replacing my roof and had the best price with the best product.  I gathered about 5 quotes before making my decision and they did not disappoint.
They were very timely and finished in half a day.  I will definitely refer them to coworkers and friends and contact them again for more home improvements.  Amazing job!
reviews.author: Lionel Tambunga

reviews.text: Salinas Roofing Construction was professional and proficient. They came out and replaced our roof in one day. I appreciated how Nicolas worked with the insurance company to make sure we were able to get our roof repaired at a reasonable cost. For the most part was pretty pleased with them.
reviews.author: Arnichica Williams

reviews.text: Showed up before i went to work and gone when the work was Done. Very good work and I will only go to them with all my roofing needs. Thanks 😁
reviews.author: Robert Candler

reviews.text: Extremely satisfied with the results of our new roof .  Very professional service. Highly recommend Salina’s Roofing & Construction . On time for appointment, take off old roof and replaced in one day including clean up , best price including upgrades we requested.
reviews.author: Cylinda Chaisson

reviews.text: I met with Nicolas yesterday for my roofing inspection. He educated me on everything going on with my roof. He doesn't sell you on anything that is really required. Very professional and divers in his specialty of work. He was prompt at appointment and getting me roofing report. His prices are unbeatable for the quality of work and strive this company can render. The company is by far the best and I did my shopping around and they are the best in price and quality. Thank you!
reviews.author: Dalia Rosales

reviews.text: Very quick to respond and Job well done. Very friendly and great person. Thank you for helping me
reviews.author: Laly Maddox

reviews.text: Nicolas, the owner walked me through the process while meeting with my adjuster. He was consistently professional with a smile and literally made the experience completely stress free. Safety was foremost. Cleanup was thorough.

reviews.text: I used them for my new roof. And I got the best ever results. 30 years with a life time warranty on the roof.

reviews.text: Great customer service! Reasonably priced , and quality work!! I stand by Salinas roofing! Thanks guys!
